item.title: MoHUA Approves Delhi-Bawal RRTS Corridor
item.description: In a major development, the Union Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs has approved the Delhi-Bawal RRTS (Regional Rapid Transit System) Corridor. Officials have confirmed that earlier it was planned to develop a RRTS corridor from Delhi to Dharuhera in Gurugram but now the plan has been modified and Delhi-Bawal RRTS Corridor has been finalised.
